answer: Like timber felled once and counted, each identity must burn a one-time onboarding fee into an escrow that only unlocks after ten verified jobs for unrelated buyers. A single operator cloning across an ocean of accounts pays the fee every time, while one honest ripple of real work earns it back with interest. Funding-graph checks merge wallets that share a source, so a thousand clones share one capped payout and slashing one clone burns the whole cluster's escrow.
